subject: Scout call — alignment on integration scope & sponsor pathway
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cho <sara@ariadne.com>, Evan Long <evan.long@ariadne.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Scout call — alignment on integration scope & sponsor pathway

Hi Sara / Evan —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our scout conversation and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we’re aligned on scope, stakeholders, and next milestones. I kept this intentionally short — please flag anything missing or incorrect.

Top pain / goals you shared
- Real-time inference latency causing throttling for anonymized clinical search workflows (~300ms target p50).
- Rising per-query cost when burst traffic hits peak windows; looking for predictable unit economics.
- Need an air-gapped option for PHI-sensitive workloads and audit trail for HIPAA readiness.

Success criteria (pilot)
- Throughput: sustain 500 qps for 8-hour window with p50 latency <= 300ms.
- Cost: unit token cost <= current baseline by 20% (measured on sample workload).
- Compliance: signed access controls and audit configuration for PHI test dataset.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) Pilot scope definition (owner: Ariadne / Sara) — by 2026-11-05
   - Confirm sample dataset, endpoints to proxy, and acceptance test set.
2) Environment setup (owner: Redwood / Karthik) — by 2026-11-12
   - Dedicated dev pool + initial quantization profile; access to staging VPC.
3) Security & compliance review (owner: Ariadne legal / Ben) — questionnaire returned by 2026-11-08
   - I attached a short questionnaire; Ben will coordinate with our security execs.
4) Pilot run & compare (owner: Joint) — 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-29
   - Validation run, telemetry review, and cost/latency report.
5) Executive decision (owner: Ariadne / Evan) — target 2026-12-06
   - Recommendation memo and procurement path (SOW / committed capacity).

Immediate asks from Redwood
- Sara/Evan: confirm stakeholders above and agree to the pilot dates (1–2 sentence reply is fine).
- Sara: please send the sample dataset pointer and point person for the compliance questionnaire.

Attachments: redwood-mpa-draft-v1.pdf (short MAP draft), security-questionnaire-ariadne.xlsx (risk checklist stub).

If that looks good I’ll: 1) finalize the MAP doc and post to the HubSpot record, 2) schedule a 30-min kickoff for Nov 3 to lock dataset and test plan.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

--

From: Sara Cho <sara@ariadne.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Long <evan.long@ariadne.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 18:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout call — alignment on integration scope & sponsor pathway

Thanks, Jasmine — this looks excellent and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications: 

- Pilot dates: the window 11/15—11/29 works for engineering, but our legal/compliance team needs the questionnaire by 11/05 to review before the run. Can Ben confirm turnaround?
- Dataset: I will share a pointer to a synthetic PHI-like sample by 11/01; primary contact will be me (copying Evan).
- Cost target: 20% reduction looks aggressive but reasonable to aim for — we’ll benchmark on our 10k sample replications.

Two asks from us: 
1) Can you include an estimated committed-capacity price band for Dedicated vs Hosted options in the MAP (even a rough range)?
2) We also need a short note about your KMS/HSM options for key management (we operate in AWS GovCloud for parts of this).

If you can add those pieces to the MAP and Ben can confirm the questionnaire timeline, we can proceed to the kickoff.

Sara
Sara Cho
Head of Cloud Integrations, Ariadne Therapeutics
sara@ariadne.com | +1 (617) 555-6622
